arxiv-2010-13951.title: Penalty methods for variational quantum eigensolver
arxiv-2010-13951.creator: Kohdai Kuroiwa, Yuya O. Nakagawa
arxiv-2010-13951.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Kohdai Kuroiwa, Yuya O. Nakagawa. The variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) is a promising algorithm to compute eigenstates and eigenenergies of a given quantum system that can be performed on a near-term quantum computer. Obtaining eigenstates and eigenenergies in a specific symmetry sector of the system is often necessary for practical applications of the VQE in various fields ranging from high energy physics to quantum chemistry.

arxiv-2104-10013.title: Parallel Physics-Informed Neural Networks via Domain Decomposition Journal: Journal of Computational Physics, doi: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jcp.2021.110683
arxiv-2104-10013.creator: Khemraj Shukla, Ameya D. Jagtap, George Em Karniadakis ∗
arxiv-2104-10013.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Khemraj Shukla, Ameya D. Jagtap, George Em Karniadakis ∗. We develop a distributed framework for the physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) based on two recent extensions, namely conservative PINNs (cPINNs) and extended PINNs (XPINNs), which employ domain decomposition in space and in time-space, respectively. This domain decomposition endows cPINNs and XPINNs with several advantages over the vanilla PINNs, such as parallelization capacity, large representation capacity, efficient hyperparameter tuning, and is particularly effective for multi-scale and multi-physics problems.

arxiv-2108-09200.title: GUDIE: a flexible, user-defined method to extract subgraphs of interest from large graphs
arxiv-2108-09200.creator: Maria Inês Silva, David Aparício, Beatriz Malveiro, João Tiago Ascensão, Pedro Bizarro
arxiv-2108-09200.description: Abstract Large, dense, small-world networks often emerge from social phenomena, including financial networks, social media, or epidemiology. As networks grow in importance, it is often necessary to partition them into meaningful units of analysis. In this work, we propose GUDIE, a message-passing algorithm that extracts relevant context around seed nodes based on user-defined criteria.

arxiv-2404-01083.description: Abstract Currently envisioned extensions of the Event Horizon Telescope to space will soon target the black hole photon ring: a narrow ring-shaped imprint of a black hole’s strong gravity produced in its images by highly bent photon trajectories. arxiv-2508-02331.title: Varieties with representable CH 0 {\rm CH}_{0} -group and a question of Colliot-Thélène
arxiv-2508-02331.creator: Claire Voisin
arxiv-2508-02331.description: Abstract We continue our investigation of the geometry of the Albanese morphism on 0-cycles. We provide an example of a smooth projective variety with representable CH 0 {\rm CH}_{0} -group but with no universal 0 0 -cycle, which answers a question asked by Colliot-Thélène. Our construction relies on a counterexample to the integral Hodge conjecture provided by Benoist and Ottem.
